modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZElement. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZElement
declarations.summary: The living base: carries interaction states as :state() and emits z-state.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-element state="glow: over">
  <button>Envoyer</button>
</z-element>
<style>
  z-element:state(press) > button { scale: .97; }
  z-element:state(glow)  > button { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--z-accent-soft); }
</style>

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Durable selection (checked, active tab) — set by a selectable component.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Status: loading / processing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Status: error.

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Status: valid / done.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name — used only by components that submit a value.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until this control has a value.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: `état: condition, …`: custom states, each with an optional condition — state="armed: press +2s, glow: over, busy". Comma separates; `:` adds a condition (gesture like `press +2s`, or clock `every 2s`); no condition = posed at once.

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssProperties.name: --z-dur-enter
cssProperties.description: Duration of the transient `enter` state (read from the cascade).

cssProperties.name: --z-contact-zone
cssProperties.description: Minimum size of the invisible touch zone every interactive element gets (skin token, 44px by default). Override it locally to enlarge one element's zone.

members.name: setState(name, on = true)
members.description: Sets or clears a state. A durable or CSS-declared state goes through its attribute; any other name is posed directly in :state().

members.name: toggleState(name)
members.description: Flips a state.

members.name: play(word)
members.description: Plays a transient state and resolves when it ends (duration read from --z-dur-<word>). `await el.play("exit")` before `el.remove()`.

members.name: states
members.description: The states active right now.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Read-only mirror of the `disabled` attribute.

members.name: setFormValue(value)
members.description: What the element submits in its form; `null` submits nothing (components call it, pages rarely do).

members.name: setValidity(message?)
members.description: Declares the element invalid with a message, or valid without one.

members.name: checkValidity() · reportValidity()
members.description: The standard constraint-validation API, as on a native input.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZLayer. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZLayer
declarations.summary: The pieces of a component — its background, its label, its tick — already painted for you. You only write a layer to take over one precise part.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-checkbox>
  <z-layer part="background"></z-layer>
  <z-layer part="marker">
    <z-layer part="ring"></z-layer>
    <z-layer part="dot"></z-layer>
  </z-layer>
  <z-layer part="infos">
    <z-layer part="label">J'accepte les conditions</z-layer>
  </z-layer>
  <z-layer part="contact"></z-layer>
</z-checkbox>

attributes.name: part
attributes.description: The role this layer plays (background, marker, ring, dot, label, icon…). Shared across components: the same word means the same thing everywhere.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of z-channel. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: z-channel
declarations.summary: The channel: two elements sharing the same channel="name" are linked. What changes here moves there — and the CSS decides what. No class, no listener.
declarations.description: Example:

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: This element's channel name(s), space-separated (channel="x y"). The subscription IS the attribute: adding it joins, removing it leaves.

cssProperties.name: --z-channel-{nom}
cssProperties.description: Set by the tool on every member: the channel's current value. Read it in CSS — calc(var(--z-channel-tempo) * 1%).

cssProperties.name: --z-channel-{nom}--{part}
cssProperties.description: When the source has several outputs (a z-range: low/high), one variable per part, using the pact's double separator.

members.name: tune(name, value)
members.description: Exported function — writes a value on a channel from JS (a server, a clock); every member follows.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZContact. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZContact
declarations.summary: Need a click effect across your whole page? Drop this tag anywhere — problem solved. Two effects by default; not to your taste? Make your own in a few lines of CSS.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-contact></z-contact>
<!-- one tag anywhere in the page: every interactive element gets the skin's click effect -->

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: Kill switch only; the effect itself belongs to the skin. — `none`: cut the effect on this page — fx's ONLY role. WHICH effect shows belongs to the skin, never the page

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Set by the engine on every source but the last one — the last declared wins.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `<longueur>`: e.g. 24px — sets --z-contact-size

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: `<longueur>`: e.g. 2px — sets --z-contact-width

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: `<durée>`: e.g. 2s — sets --z-contact-duration

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: `<couleur>`: e.g. tomato — sets --z-contact-color

events.name: zoe:contact
events.description: Emitted on the touched target. detail: { fx, x, y, size, duration, pointerType }.

cssProperties.name: --z-contact-color
cssProperties.description: Colour — defaults to the accent of the touched element.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZCursor. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZCursor
declarations.summary: The pointer's wake: one flat tag, and the mouse leaves a ribbon behind it.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-cursor fx="move" tone="main"></z-cursor>

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: move (the ribbon follows the mouse, default) · click (it fuses from one click to the next) · none.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Colours the wake with the tone (main · complement · soft).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Thickness of the wake, on the shared scale (xs → xl).

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-scale
cssProperties.description: Multiplies the thickness — what the `size` attribute sets.

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-fade
cssProperties.description: Life of a point (ms) — the wake's length.

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-smooth
cssProperties.description: Follow smoothness: low = it trails, 1 = glued to the pointer.

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-speed-ref
cssProperties.description: Mouse speed (px/ms) that fills the head.

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-speed-fuse
cssProperties.description: Speed (px/ms) of the trip from one click to the next.

cssProperties.name: --z-trail-ease
cssProperties.description: Head→tail falloff: linear quad cubic quart quint expo sine back.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZDrag. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZDrag
declarations.summary: Dragging is the single biggest pile of JavaScript in any interface. Wrap it in this tag: the position lands in CSS as a number, and YOU decide what it moves — a position, a rotation, an opacity. Keyboard included.

attributes.name: axis
attributes.description: Locks the gesture to one axis. Optional: reading only __x in your CSS already gives a horizontal slider — this attribute exists so the GESTURE itself refuses the other direction, which is what a finger feels. — `x`: horizontal only · `y`: vertical only

attributes.name: bounds
attributes.description: Keeps the object inside its parent, and turns on __rx / __ry — the share travelled, 0→1. Without it the object goes wherever the hand goes.

events.name: zoe:drop
events.description: Emitted on release — the only moment a page has something to do. detail: { x, y, rx, ry }.

cssProperties.name: --z-drag__x
cssProperties.description: The position along X, in pixels from the starting point — a bare number, so multiply it into whatever you want moved.

cssProperties.name: --z-drag__y
cssProperties.description: The position along Y, in pixels from the starting point.

cssProperties.name: --z-drag__rx
cssProperties.description: With bounds: the share travelled horizontally, 0→1 — a slider's value, for free.

cssProperties.name: --z-drag__ry
cssProperties.description: With bounds: the share travelled vertically, 0→1.

cssProperties.name: --z-drag__held
cssProperties.description: 1 while the object is held, 0 once let go — for the shadow that lifts under the finger.

cssStates.name: held
cssStates.description: z-drag:state(held) while the object is held. It doubles the token, and neither covers the other: a selector switches (a cursor, a z-index), a number interpolates (a scale, a shadow).

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZInview. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZInview
declarations.summary: "Fade it in when it scrolls into view" — the single most common request on the web, and the reason whole libraries get loaded. Wrap it in this tag: the answer arrives in CSS as a number, and the animation stays yours to write.
declarations.description:
Example:

Ce titre entre en scène

attributes.name: margin
attributes.description: Grows or shrinks the screen for this element only. A negative value waits until it is well inside; a positive one prepares it before it arrives. — `<longueur>`: e.g. -80px — trigger later, once it is really in view

cssProperties.name: --z-inview__in
cssProperties.description: 1 as soon as a single pixel is on screen, 0 otherwise — for what should play again at every pass.

cssProperties.name: --z-inview__ratio
cssProperties.description: The visible share of the element, 0→1. It saturates at 1 once the element fits entirely on screen.

cssProperties.name: --z-inview__seen
cssProperties.description: 1 once seen — and it NEVER goes back down. An entrance does not replay: this is the number that stops a page from making you dizzy on the way back up.

cssProperties.name: --z-inview__cross
cssProperties.description: The crossing of the screen: 0 entering from the bottom, 1 leaving through the top. The number that keeps moving when ratio has saturated — for a decor that drifts the whole way through.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of z-lint. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: z-lint
declarations.summary: The console that corrects: load it in development and every unknown tag, attribute, state, part or misspelled token is reported with the nearest valid name. The browser stays silent; z-lint speaks.
declarations.description:
Example:

<script type="module" src="tools/z-lint/z-lint.js"></script>

events.name: zoe:lint
events.description: Fired on `document` after each pass. detail: { findings } — each finding has level, kind, found, expected, message.

members.name: ZoeLint.lint()
members.description: Re-runs the analysis on the whole page and returns the findings (also printed to the console).

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZPointer. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZPointer
declarations.summary: Want a div to follow the mouse? Wrap it in this tag — the position lands in CSS as plain numbers, and every child inherits them. No class, no listener, no JS of yours.

attributes.name: local
attributes.description: Coordinates in the BOX's frame (0,0 = its top-left corner). Taken by default when no frame is asked for — it is the common case, and the cheapest.

attributes.name: global
attributes.description: Coordinates in the WINDOW's frame (0,0 = its top-left corner). The pointer is then followed everywhere, even outside the box — useful for a crosshair or a page-wide light.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--local__x
cssProperties.description: Distance from the box's left edge, in pixels — a bare number, so multiply it (* 1px).

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--local__y
cssProperties.description: Distance from the box's top edge, in pixels.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--local__rx
cssProperties.description: The share of the box crossed horizontally, 0→1 — becomes an angle (* 360deg), a share (* 100%), anything.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--local__ry
cssProperties.description: The share of the box crossed vertically, 0→1.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--local__in
cssProperties.description: 1 while the pointer is inside the box, 0 outside — the switch a skin uses to fade a halo out cleanly.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--global__x
cssProperties.description: Distance from the window's left edge, in pixels.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--global__y
cssProperties.description: Distance from the window's top edge, in pixels.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--global__rx
cssProperties.description: The share of the window crossed horizontally, 0→1.

cssProperties.name: --z-pointer--global__ry
cssProperties.description: The share of the window crossed vertically, 0→1.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZScroll. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZScroll
declarations.summary: A progress bar, a shrinking header, a parallax, a "back to top" that waits its turn — all of them need one thing: how far down are we? Drop this tag and the answer lands in CSS as a number between 0 and 1.
declarations.description: Example:

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: Measure the PAGE's scroll instead of this box. The numbers are then set on :root, readable everywhere — the page's scroll belongs to no one in particular.

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__ry
cssProperties.description: The share scrolled vertically, 0 at the start, 1 at the end — the number that serves 90% of the time.

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__y
cssProperties.description: The distance scrolled vertically, in pixels — a bare number, so multiply it (* 1px).

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__x
cssProperties.description: The distance scrolled horizontally, in pixels.

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__dir
cssProperties.description: 1 going down, -1 going up. It keeps its last value at rest — the one number you can never get otherwise, since it needs the previous position.

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__top
cssProperties.description: 1 while nothing has moved from the start — for a header that only shrinks once you leave the top.

cssProperties.name: --z-scroll__end
cssProperties.description: 1 when the end is reached — for the shadow that fades out once there is nothing left to see.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZSize. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZSize
declarations.summary: Two questions CSS cannot answer on its own: how big is this box, really — and does its content overflow? Wrap it in this tag and both answers land in CSS as numbers.
declarations.description:
Example:

Ce texte grandit avec sa boîte.

cssProperties.name: --z-size__w
cssProperties.description: The inner width, in pixels — a bare number, so multiply it. This is what container queries never give you: a value to interpolate.

cssProperties.name: --z-size__ratio
cssProperties.description: Width divided by height. Above 1 it is lying down, below 1 it is standing up — one number to swap a layout on shape rather than on size.

cssProperties.name: --z-size__over
cssProperties.description: 1 if the content overflows on either side. THE question CSS has no answer for — and the reason so many edge shadows and "see more" arrows mean nothing.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZAccordion. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZAccordion
declarations.summary: A group of z-disclosure — when `exclusive`, opening one closes the others. Coordination only.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-accordion exclusive>
  <z-disclosure open>
    <z-layer part="label">Livraison</z-layer>
    <z-layer part="panel">Sous 48 h en France métropolitaine.</z-layer>
  </z-disclosure>
  <z-disclosure>
    <z-layer part="label">Retours</z-layer>
    <z-layer part="panel">30 jours, sans justificatif.</z-layer>
  </z-disclosure>
</z-accordion>

attributes.name: exclusive
attributes.description: Only one disclosure open at a time — opening one closes the others.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Bubbles from the disclosure that opened or closed; the group has already closed the others if exclusive.

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

members.name: exclusive
members.description: Mirrors the `exclusive` attribute.

members.name: disclosures
members.description: The z-disclosure children this accordion coordinates.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZAlert. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZAlert
declarations.summary: A contextual message — tone drives the colour, role=status (or alert for danger). Optionally dismissible.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-alert tone="success">Vos modifications sont enregistrées.</z-alert>
<z-alert tone="danger" dismissible>Le paiement a été refusé.</z-alert>

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: The kind of message — drives colour and, for danger, the live politeness.

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Adds a × ; closes on click (on the ×) or Delete/Backspace when focused.

events.name: zoe:dismiss
events.description: Cancelable — fired before closing. preventDefault() to handle it yourself.

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssParts.name: background
cssParts.description: The banner surface — carries the tone.

cssParts.name: infos
cssParts.description: What informs — icon + message.

cssParts.name: icon
cssParts.description: infos › Optional status icon. (optional)

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: infos › The message.

members.name: dismiss()
members.description: Closes the alert: fires cancelable `zoe:dismiss`, then plays `exit` and removes the node.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZAvatar. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZAvatar
declarations.summary: An identity chip — an image if given, otherwise the initials. role=img with an alt from name. Inherits tone/size.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-avatar name="Ada Lovelace">AL</z-avatar>
<z-avatar name="Grace Hopper" src="/img/grace.jpg"></z-avatar>
<z-avatar name="Inconnu" size="l" tone="soft">?</z-avatar>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL — set as the host's background (no injected ).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The person/thing shown — becomes the accessible alt (role=img + aria-label).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant.

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssParts.name: background
cssParts.description: The disc — carries the image or the tone.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The initials (fallback when there's no image).

members.name: src
members.description: The image URL (mirrors the attribute).

members.name: name
members.description: The accessible name (mirrors the attribute).

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZAvatarGroup. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZAvatarGroup
declarations.summary: A stack of overlapping z-avatar, each ringed in the page colour to stand out. On hover, the avatar lifts and comes to the front. Nothing injected.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-avatar-group max="3">
  <z-avatar name="Ada Lovelace">AL</z-avatar>
  <z-avatar name="Grace Hopper">GH</z-avatar>
  <z-avatar name="Margaret Hamilton">MH</z-avatar>
  <z-avatar name="4 autres personnes" tone="soft">+4</z-avatar>
</z-avatar-group>

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Author's guide: past this many faces, add a final <z-avatar>+N</z-avatar> yourself (no node is generated).

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssProperties.name: --z-avatar-group__overlap
cssProperties.description: How much each avatar slides over the previous one (negative margin).

cssProperties.name: --z-avatar-group__ring
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the separating ring (page colour).

cssProperties.name: --z-avatar-group__lift
cssProperties.description: How high the hovered avatar rises.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZBadge. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZBadge
declarations.summary: A status/count pill — inherits z-element's tone & size variants, painted by the skin. Almost zero code: the frozen socle does the work.

<z-badge>Nouveau</z-badge>
<z-badge tone="danger">3</z-badge>
<z-badge tone="success" size="s">payé</z-badge>

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Importance/colour, from the socle variant.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant (everything follows in em).

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssParts.name: background
cssParts.description: The pill surface — carries tone and effects.

cssParts.name: infos
cssParts.description: What informs — the badge's text/number.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: infos › Your text.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZBreadcrumb. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZBreadcrumb
declarations.summary: A breadcrumb trail — you write the links, Zoé adds the meaning (nav + label) and the « › » separators in CSS. Nothing injected.
declarations.description: Example: Accueil Boutique Chaussures

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the navigation (defaults to « Fil d'Ariane »).

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZButton. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZButton
declarations.summary: A button — inherits all z-element states, skinnable by themes.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-button>Envoyer</z-button>
<z-button tone="soft">Annuler</z-button>
<z-button loading>Chargement…</z-button>
<form>
  <z-button type="submit">Valider</z-button>
  <z-button type="reset" tone="soft">Réinitialiser</z-button>
</form>

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: What it does inside a form: submit (default), reset, or nothing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading (skeleton sweep, not clickable).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error (danger border + shake).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Valid (success border).

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssParts.name: background
cssParts.description: The button's surface and outline — painted, a piece of its own: it can move without the text.

cssParts.name: icon

members.name: type

declarations.name: ZCard

Titre de la carte

Contenu libre : texte, images, autres composants.

 Toute la carte est cliquable.

attributes.name: tone

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZCheckbox. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZCheckbox
declarations.summary: A checkbox — inherits all z-element states, marker + label anatomy, painted by the skin.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-checkbox name="cgu" required>J'accepte les conditions</z-checkbox>
<z-checkbox name="lettre" value="hebdo" current>Recevoir la lettre</z-checkbox>
<z-checkbox indeterminate>Tout cocher</z-checkbox>

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Checked: a durable selection set by the component (click / Space).

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Neither checked nor unchecked — the state of a 'check all' box whose children disagree. Any click resolves it to checked.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: What is submitted when checked (default: "on", like the native input).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until this box is checked.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Invalid (e.g. required and unchecked).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Valid.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the checked state toggles. Read `.checked`.

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssParts.name: marker
cssParts.description: The box itself — painted, nothing to write. Its outline is `ring`, its mark is `dot`.

cssParts.name: ring
cssParts.description: marker › The box outline (the border of the painted box).

cssParts.name: dot
cssParts.description: marker › The mark that appears once checked (the box's inner square).

cssParts.name: icon
cssParts.description: Optional content, before the text: `<z-layer part="icon">✳</z-layer>`. (optional)

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: Your text — written directly inside the element.

cssParts.name: contact
cssParts.description: The touch zone — invisible, at least --z-contact-zone (44px), centred on the box. Set by the core.

members.name: checked
members.description: Checked or not — mirrors `current`. Setting it never clears `indeterminate`.

members.name: indeterminate
members.description: The third value (aria-checked=mixed).

members.name: value
members.description: What is submitted when checked (default "on").

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZCheckboxGroup. Do not edit by hand.

modules.description: Generated by scripts/z-manifest from the `static api` of ZSlider. Do not edit by hand.

declarations.name: ZSlider
declarations.summary: A value slider — poses progress (0→1) in the cascade, the skin paints everything.
declarations.description:
Example:

<z-slider min="0" max="100" value="40" name="volume"></z-slider>
<z-slider value="25" step="5" markers label="over"></z-slider>
<z-slider orientation="vertical" value="60"></z-slider>

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value. Clamped to [min, max] and snapped to step.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Lower bound (default 0).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Upper bound (default 100).

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Increment. `any` for a continuous slider (default 1).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Track direction. Vertical runs bottom→top: up means more.

attributes.name: markers
attributes.description: Graduations. Bare = one per step; a number = that many intervals.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Where the value is written, relative to the track. `none` (default) writes nothing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted on every value change, including during the drag. Read `.value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted once the gesture is over (pointer released, key up).

events.name: z-state
events.description: Emitted on every state change. detail: { states, changed, on }.

cssProperties.name: --z-slider__progress
cssProperties.description: 0→1, posed by the component. Everything else is derived from it in CSS.

cssProperties.name: --z-slider__value
cssProperties.description: The value, so the CSS can write it via counter() without any injected node.

cssProperties.name: --z-slider__markers
cssProperties.description: Number of intervals between graduations (0 = none).

cssParts.name: background
cssParts.description: The track: the empty rail, from min to max.

cssParts.name: ticks
cssParts.description: background › The graduations, drawn as a gradient — animatable as one block. (optional)

cssParts.name: marker
cssParts.description: The filled part, from min to the value. It IS the state, made visible.

cssParts.name: dot
cssParts.description: marker › The handle, sitting at the end of the fill.

cssParts.name: infos
cssParts.description: What informs — follows the handle, placed by the `label` attribute.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: infos › The value written out. Left empty, the CSS fills it from --z-slider__value.

cssParts.name: contact
cssParts.description: What receives the gesture — overflows the thin track so it stays easy to grab.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value, clamped to [min, max] and snapped to step. Setting it animates (progress is a typed @property).

members.name: min · max · step
members.description: The bounds and increment (read-only mirrors of the attributes).

members.name: progress
members.description: 0→1, the position along the track.
